Closest to the venue · most likely unavailable

These are the closest boards to the venue, and realistically we most likely cannot use them, so treat this as the wish list rather than the plan. The two literal closest sit right at the Morrison exit, about 2.2 miles out, but they are older non-conforming structures and the state only lists an out-of-state landowner. The current ads on them are Outcrop Red Rocks and Alchemy, so I am reaching out to those brands to find who they bought the space from and run down the actual owner. The other three are OUTFRONT's cluster on I-70 just east of C-470, about 3.9 miles out, facing west toward Red Rocks. Chase confirmed the rates, $5,000 to $6,000 a face for a week, but said these are the only faces he could even explore a one or two-week flight on and they are not bookable short-term right now. Nothing in the state list sits closer than about two miles, since Morrison is a protected scenic area.
